title: The sons of Rachava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are Ifa and Avimi, the sharp scholars of Pumbedita, as in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5). See their entries.[^1]

notes.text: The Gemara specifically calls Ifa and Avimi, the sons of Rachava, the “sharp scholars of Pumbedita.” [Heilprin’s Ifa entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2894&lang=en) lists the same pair. The notice gives no basis for matching this Avimi to one of the other men with that name.
